main.description: Authenticated resolution of the name a sender addressed. A role resolves to its target; a retired name with a successor forwards to the successor. At most 3 hops are followed. name is the final row and chain lists every name from the requested one to it. did is the final row's DID when the issuer knows it; it is absent for a reserved name. A sender seals to did and sends with resolvedFrom set to the requested name; the mailbox repeats this resolution at accept time.

errors.name: RoleUnresolved
errors.description: The chain cycles or needs more than 3 hops. The message lists the chain.

errors.name: Retired
errors.description: The chain ends at a retired name with no successor. The message lists the chain.
